findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: posts.publish_post, videos.status, credits.balance · Public sink: networks.properties, posts.publish_post, posts.insights, videos.status, credits.balance, account.overview · Destructive: connections.remove.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: posts.publish_post, videos.status, credits.balance · Public sink: networks.properties, posts.publish_post, posts.insights, videos.status, credits.balance, account.overview · Destructive: connections.remove

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
